Name: AT Reisha's Guinea Pig (Animated)
Author: ReishaKinoko
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zUv9ZmS.png[/img]Animated guinea pig furniture for Alternative Textures. Because Abigail misses her pet David and everyone wants one too. Let me know if you want more pets terrariums in the future. I hope you enjoy it!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UgAXnsq.png[/img]Just download the mod pack, extract and paste it in the Stardew Valley's Mods folder. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod is required.
I also recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] to decor your home more easily. In game, find the AT for "Dark Cat Tree".
